bear_assumptions: Volume contraction persists, price/mix loses effectiveness, restructuring disappoints and leverage constrains cash returns and the dividend.
base_assumptions: Volume stabilizes gradually, restructuring and mix improve margins, working capital supports cash conversion and leverage remains manageable.
bull_assumptions: Brand investment restores volume, pricing holds, restructuring delivers a durable margin step-up and free cash flow reduces leverage while covering distributions.
rating_change_conditions: Upgrade only after volume, margin, leverage and an accepted relationship clear all gates; downgrade if restructuring fails, volume remains weak, cash conversion deteriorates or distributions raise financing risk.
